        dy = target.y - self.robot.position.y
        dist = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
        if dist < 1e-5:
            return self.robot.position

        # Normalize direction
        speed_factor = min(speed, ROBOT_SPEED * ROLE_ABILITIES[self.robot.role]["speed_bonus"])
        unit_x = dx / dist * speed_factor
        unit_y = dy / dist * speed_factor

        new_x = self.robot.position.x + unit_x
        new_y = self.robot.position.y + unit_y

        # Simple wall collision avoidance
        if self._is_wall(new_x, new_y):
            # Try to go around
            offsets = [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, -1), (-1, 0)]
            for dxo, dyo in offsets:
                nx = new_x + dxo * 10
                ny = new_y + dyo * 10
                if 0 <= nx < WORLD_WIDTH and 0 <= ny < WORLD_HEIGHT and not self._is_wall(nx, ny):
                    new_x, new_y = nx, ny
                    break

        return Position(max(0, min(WORLD_WIDTH, new_x)), max(0, min(WORLD_HEIGHT, new_y)))

    def _is_wall(self, x: float, y: float) -> bool:
        # Simplified: check if position is near any wall
        for wx, wy in self.game_state.map.walls:
            if abs(x - wx) < 20 and abs(y - wy) < 20:
                return True
        return False

    def _attack(self, enemy: Robot):
        weapon = WEAPON_TYPES[self.robot.weapon]
        damage = weapon["damage"]
        if self.robot.shield_active:
            damage *= 1.2  # bonus damage when shielded
        enemy.health -= damage
        self.robot.cooldown = weapon["cooldown"]
        self.robot.energy -= weapon["energy_cost"]
        if enemy.health <= 0:
            self.game_state.scores[self.robot.team] += 5
            # Mark as eliminated
            enemy.health = 0
            self.comm_system.broadcast(self.robot, {
                "type": "enemy_eliminated",
                "enemy_id": enemy.id
            })

# ============================
# GAME LOOP AND INITIALIZATION
# ============================

class TeamTacticsGame:
    def __init__(self):
        self.state = GameState()
        self.comm_system = CommunicationSystem(self.state)
        self.agents: List[AgentBehavior] = []
        self.init_game()

    def init_game(self):
        # Generate map
        self.state.map = Map()
        self.state.map.bases[0] = Position(100, 400)
        self.state.map.bases[1] = Position(900, 400)
        self.state.map.flags[0] = Position(900, 400)  # flag at enemy base
        self.state.map.flags[1] = Position(100, 400)
        self.state.map.heal_pads = [
            Position(300, 200),
            Position(700, 600),
            Position(500, 400)
        ]
        self.state.map.walls = [
            (500, 200), (500, 220), (500, 240), (500, 260), (500, 280),
            (500, 520), (500, 540), (500, 560), (500, 580), (500, 600),
            (400, 400), (420, 400), (440, 400), (460, 400), (480, 400),
            (520, 400), (540, 400), (560, 400), (580, 400), (600, 400)
        ]

        # Create objectives
        self.state.objectives = [
            Objective(ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG, self.state.map.flags[0], team=0),
            Objective(ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG, self.state.map.flags[1], team=1),
            Objective(ObjectiveType.DEFEND_BASE, self.state.map.bases[0], team=0),
            Objective(ObjectiveType.DEFEND_BASE, self.state.map.bases[1], team=1),
        ]

        # Create robots
        robot_id = 0
        for team in range(TEAM_COUNT):
            for role_idx, role in enumerate([RobotRole.ATTACKER, RobotRole.DEFENDER, RobotRole.SCOUT, RobotRole.HEALER, RobotRole.ATTACKER]):
                if role_idx >= MAX_ROBOTS_PER_TEAM:
                    break
                pos = self.state.map.bases[team]
                robot = Robot(
                    id=robot_id,
                    team=team,
                    role=role,
                    position=Position(pos.x + random.randint(-20, 20), pos.y + random.randint(-20, 20))
                )
                robot.apply_ability()
                self.state.robots.append(robot)
                robot_id += 1

        # Initialize agents
        self.agents = [AgentBehavior(r, self.state, self.comm_system) for r in self.state.robots]

    def update(self, dt: float = 0.1):
        if not self.state.active:
            return

        # Update game time
        self.state.time += dt

        # Update each agent
        for agent in self.agents:
            agent.update(dt)

        # Check win conditions
        for obj in self.state.objectives:
            if obj.type == ObjectiveType.CAPTURE_FLAG and obj.completed:
                self.state.winner = obj.team
                self.state.active = False
                return

        # Check if all enemies eliminated
        for team in range(TEAM_COUNT):
            alive = [r for r in self.state.robots if r.team == team and r.health > 0]
            if len(alive) == 0:
                self.state.winner = 1 - team
                self.state.active = False
                return

    def get_game_status(self):
        return {
            "time": self.state.time,
            "scores": self.state.scores,
            "winner": self.state.winner,
            "active": self.state.active,
            "robots": [
                {
                    "id": r.id,
                    "team": r.team,
                    "role": r.role.value,
                    "health": r.health,
                    "energy": r.energy,
                    "position": {"x": r.position.x, "y": r.position.y},
                    "alive": r.health > 0,
                    "objective": r.objective.value if r.objective else None
                } for r in self.state.robots
            ],
            "objectives": [
                {
                    "type": obj.type.value,
                    "team": obj.team,
                    "completed": obj.completed,
                    "progress": obj.progress
                } for obj in self.state.objectives
            ],
            "messages": len(self.comm_system.message_history)
        }

    def run_simulation(self, duration: float = 60.0):
        start_time = time.time()
        while self.state.active and time.time() - start_time < duration:
            self.update(0.1)
            time.sleep(0.01)  # Simulate real-time
        return self.get_game_status()

def test_capture_flag():
    game = TeamTacticsGame()
    # Force flag to be close to attackers
    game.state.map.flags[0] = Position(200, 400)  # Red team's flag is near Red base
    game.state.objectives[0].team = 0  # Red team captures its own flag
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 0 and robot.role == RobotRole.ATTACKER:
            robot.position = Position(205, 400)  # Right next to flag
    # Run simulation
    result = game.run_simulation(10)
    assert result["winner"] == 0, "Red team should win by capturing flag"
    print("test_capture_flag: PASSED")

def test_defend_base():
    game = TeamTacticsGame()
    # Place enemy agents near base
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 1:
            robot.position = Position(110, 400)  # Right at Red base
    # Run simulation
    result = game.run_simulation(15)
    assert result["winner"] == 0, "Red team should win by defending base"
    print("test_defend_base: PASSED")

def test_eliminate_all_enemies():
    game = TeamTacticsGame()
    # Reduce enemy health to 10
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 1:
            robot.health = 10
    # Run simulation with high damage role
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 0:
            robot.weapon = "sniper_rifle"
    result = game.run_simulation(20)
    assert result["winner"] == 0, "Red team should win by eliminating all enemies"
    print("test_eliminate_all_enemies: PASSED")

def test_no_communication():
    game = TeamTacticsGame()
    # Disable communication
    game.comm_system.broadcast = lambda *args: None
    # Place enemies to overwhelm one agent
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 1:
            robot.position = Position(150, 400)
    # Run simulation
    result = game.run_simulation(15)
    assert result["winner"] == 1, "Blue team should win if Red fails to coordinate"
    print("test_no_communication: PASSED")

def test_stuck_agent():
    game = TeamTacticsGame()
    # Place agent inside wall
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 0 and robot.role == RobotRole.SCOUT:
            robot.position = Position(500, 400)  # On a wall
    result = game.run_simulation(10)
    assert result["active"] == True, "Game should still be active even if one agent is stuck"
    print("test_stuck_agent: PASSED")

def test_ability_interaction():
    game = TeamTacticsGame()
    # Give one defender shield and one attacker pulse rifle
    for robot in game.state.robots:
        if robot.team == 0 and robot.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER:
            robot.shield_active = True
            robot.shield_duration = 10.0
        if robot.team == 1 and robot.role == RobotRole.ATTACKER:
            robot.weapon = "pulse_rifle"
    # Run simulation to test shield absorption
    result = game.run_simulation(8)
    # Defender should survive initial attack
    defender = next(r for r in game.state.robots if r.team == 0 and r.role == RobotRole.DEFENDER)
    assert defender.health > 80, "Defender with shield should have high health after attack"
    print("test_ability_interaction: PASSED")
